description: This is a PHP class definition for a dashboard widget (dashlet) named TopCampaignsDashlet, used in the SuiteCRM platform. It displays the top campaigns based on revenue from closed opportunities, with configurable options and display rendering.

classes.name: TopCampaignsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class that displays the top campaigns by revenue, extending the generic Dashlet class. It fetches data from the campaigns and opportunities tables, and renders a Smarty template.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet, fetches top campaigns data from the database, and prepares it for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet using a Smarty template, passing in campaign data.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays configurable options for the dashlet in the admin UI.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves configuration options submitted by the user.
